Could you please provide your email address? Alternatively, if you can't remember your email, I can look you up using your first name, last name, and zip code.

I need to authenticate your identity first before I can help you with your order. Could you please provide your email address?

Also, I need to inform you that according to our policy, you can only exchange items for items of the same product type. For example, you can change a luggage set to a different variant of luggage set (like a different color or size), but you cannot change it to a coat since those are different product types.
